# 🌐 LaagQueueRTP – Premium-Quality Free Plugin  

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-blue)]()  
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.19.x%20to%201.21.7-brightgreen)]()  
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Free-lightgrey)]()  

> 🚀 **LaagQueueRTP** is a high-quality, premium-level Minecraft plugin released absolutely **free** by [LaagStudio](#-credits).  
> Designed to offer top-tier performance, easy customization, and all the features you’d expect from paid plugins — without the cost.

---

## ✨ Features  

- ✅ **Premium-Level Quality** – Completely free, yet built to premium standards  
- ⚡ **Optimized Performance** – World-class junk loading process for smoother gameplay & reduced load times  
- 🎨 **Highly Configurable** – Permissions, GUI, Descriptions, RTP settings, and more  
- 🔒 **LuckPerms Support** – Works seamlessly with permission plugins like LuckPerms  
- 📈 **Future Updates** – Continuous improvements & optimizations planned  

---

## 📜 Commands  

### User Commands  
| Command        | Description                 | Permission (LuckPerms) |
|----------------|-----------------------------|------------------------|
| `/rtp`         | Random teleport command      | laagqueuertp.rtp        |
| `/rtp queue`   | Join the RTP queue           | laagqueuertp.queue      |
| `/rtpqueue`    | Alias for joining the queue  | laagqueuertp.queue      |

### Admin Commands  
| Command                                        | Description                      |
|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `/rtp admin add <world> <player>`               | Add a player to RTP in a world   |
| `/rtp admin remove <player>`                   | Remove a player from RTP queue   |
| `/rtp admin reload`                   | Reload Hello the LaagQueueRTP   |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration  

You can configure:  
- Permissions  
- GUI layouts  
- Descriptions  
- RTP configurations  
- …and much more!
